name: ImplicitLock
summary: The locking is done by the framework, so that no piece of application code can forget it.

roles.name: ImplicitLock
roles.summary: Where the acquisition of a lock is taken out of application code and put into a layer everything passes through. The reasoning is that one forgotten lock is enough to lose data, and reviewing every path forever is not a control — the same argument any repository makes for centralising a rule that must never be skipped.
